+"""Load glob configuration files."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+
+from lamina.errors import LaminaError
+from lamina.loader.core import loads
+from lamina.model import Document
+
+_CACHE: dict[str, Document] = {}
+
+
+def load_glob(path, *, strict=True, skip=None):
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(path)
+    if path in _CACHE:
+        return _CACHE[path]
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        fileText = fh.read()
+    if strict and not fileText.strip():
+        raise LaminaError(f"empty configuration: {path}", 0, 1)
+    doc = loads(fileText, base_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), strict=False)
+    doc.source = path
+    _CACHE[path] = doc
+    return doc

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.loader.glob import load_glob
+
+
+def test_glob_loads(write):
+    path = write("a_glob.conf", "[a]\nx = 1\n")
+    assert load_glob(path).get("a.x") == "1"
+
+
+def test_glob_empty_strict(write):
+    path = write("e_glob.conf", "")
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        load_glob(path, strict=True)
+
+
+def test_glob_empty_lenient(write):
+    path = write("l_glob.conf", "")
+    assert load_glob(path, strict=False).sections() == []
